'jam dpal nā ga rak+sha'i rgyun khyer bzhugs so/ /bla ma mchog gsum rig pa'i rgyal po la/ /gus pas skyabs mchi mkha' mnyam 'gro ba rnams/ /gti mug gad

tei:div.tei:p: 1$0000250'jam dpal nā ga rak+sha'i rgyun khyer bzhugs so// 1$0000300bla ma mchog gsum rig pa'i rgyal po la// gus pas skyabs mchi mkha' mnyam 'gro ba rnams// gti mug gdug pa klu yi nad gdon las// skyob phyir 'jam dpal dpa' bo bsgrub par bgyi// oṃ swa bhā ba shud+dhaḥsarba dharmaḥswa bhā ba shud+dho3 haṃ/ stong pa'i ngang las rang sems yi ge phe// nag po 'bar ba'i 'od zer 'phro bar gyur// phe rak+ṣa ku ru bh+rūm̐/ 'khor 'das so mtshams rgya mtsho chen po'i klong*// me tog nor bu gcal du bkram pa'i dbus// rin chen pho brang klu brgyad ka ba can// steng 'og phyogs mtshams sbrul gyis dkris pa'i nang*// klu gnyan sa bdag 'bum sde'i gdan steng du// rig pa'i rgyal po nā ga rak+sha pa// stang zil mdog can rtsa zhal srin po'i gdong*// rab khros sbrul mgo dgu yi gdengs ka 'phyo// dbus dmar prog zhu mi bskyod cod pan can// bcu drug phyag gi g.yas brgyad gri gug dang*// g.yon brgyad sbrul zhags dang po thugs kar bsnol// lhag ma rab gdengs rngam brjid bzod dka'i sku /ri rab la brten mjug ma rgya mtshor 'khyil// zhal nas ig sha'i sgra sgrog mche ba gtsigs// gru gsum spyan bgrad sbrul nag ral pa las// sdom sdig me yi tshwa tshwa phyogs bcur 'phro// sbrul rigs lnga dang rat+na du mas brgyan// dregs pa thams cad dngangs shing skrag pa'i gzugs// ye shes me dpung 'bar ba'i klong na brjid// thugs kar ye shes sems dpa' sbrul dkar po// g.yas 'khyil mgo bo gyen gdengs snying gar phe// mdog nag yi ge bzhi pas g.yas su bskor// 'od 'phros ye shes sems dpa' sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥganyis su med par gyur// phe las 'bar ba'i 'od zer lnga ldan 'phros// lus kyi nad gdon thams cad ba spu dang*// dbang po'i sgo nas phyi rol 'thon par gyur// oṃ phe laṃ hūm̐/

nag po ti pa tsa ya nā ga rak+sha oṃ phe laṃ hūm̐/ phyi nang snod bcud 'od zhu rang la thim// rang nyid phe dang phe yang stong par gyur// dge ba 'di yis bdag dang 'gro ba kun// gdug pa klu yi nad gdon las thar zhing*// bla na med pa'i bde dga' rgya mtsho yis// kun mkhyen ye shes go 'phang myur thob shog /
ces pa'ang don gnyer can du mas bskul ba las 'gyur med rdo rjes smras pa'o/// /
